commentary.text: 90+12' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+11' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+11' The game is interrupted. Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+11' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Folarin Balogun as he is replaced by Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco).
90+9' Rabby Nzingoula (Strasbourg) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
90+9' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+8' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Good work from Strasbourg as they win a corner.
90+6' 3 - 2 Goal! A great cross from Maghnes Akliouche finds Takumi Minamino (Monaco), who scores with a simple header into an empty net. 3:2.
90+5' Rabby Nzingoula slides a brilliant pass into Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
90+5' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
90+2' Substitution. Rabby Nzingoula (Strasbourg) on for Felix Lemarechal.
90+1' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) takes the direct free kick, but drags his shot well wide of the left post.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle after Aladji Bamba (Monaco) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Strasbourg earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
88' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
87' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) and Dilane Bakwa attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

86' Philipp Kohn was forced into action to thwart Kendry Paez (Strasbourg). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
85' A substitution has been made. Aleksandr Golovin is replaced by Takumi Minamino (Monaco).
82' Caio Henrique sends the corner to the centre of the box where Folarin Balogun (Monaco) leaps highest but pushes his header well wide of the left post.
82' Caio Henrique (Monaco) will deliver the corner kick.
82' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.

80' A nice cross arrived in the box from the corner kick and found the head of Eric Dier (Monaco). He steered the ball towards the left post, but one of the defenders is there to cover the goalkeeper and keep it out.
80' Caio Henrique (Monaco) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
79' Adi Hutter is forced to make a change. Lukas Hradecky is unable to continue due to injury, Philipp Kohn (Monaco) comes on.
79' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with George Ilenikhena (Monaco) replacing Mika Biereth.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Aladji Bamba (Monaco) for Lamine Camara.
78' The game is interrupted now, Lukas Hradecky (Monaco) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' 2 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Lukas Hradecky no chance!
76' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) is going to take the penalty!
75' Caio Henrique (Monaco) trips an opposition player and Benoit Bastien signals a foul. Strasbourg are awarded a penalty!

73' 2 - 1 What a goal! Samuel Amo-Ameyaw plays it to Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Lukas Hradecky into the right side of the goal. 2:1.
71' Here is a change. Diego Moreira is going off and Liam Rosenior gives the last tactical orders to Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg).
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) coming on for Mathis Amougou.
70' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Valentin Barco (Strasbourg), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
69' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and signals a foul after Lamine Camara (Monaco) brought his opponent down. Strasbourg win a free kick.
66' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
65' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
64' The resulting corner from Lamine Camara (Monaco) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
63' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
63' The total number of attempts is 8:5. 3:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
62' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar.
59' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
56' Joaquin Panichelli picks out Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the left post.

55' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
52' A goal, which was scored by Mika Biereth (Monaco), was disallowed due to offside.
50' No offside! Referee Benoit Bastien points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Monaco players celebrate.
49' Wait! Referee Benoit Bastien has indicated he is going to review the Monaco goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

48' 2 - 0 GOAL! A great pass finds Folarin Balogun (Monaco) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 2:0.
46' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) comes off for Kendry Paez.
46' Liam Rosenior makes a switch. Dilane Bakwa is coming on in place of Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Caio Henrique (Monaco) takes the corner but it's cleared.
45+4' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45+2' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' The corner kick from Caio Henrique (Monaco) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
44' Jordan Teze (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Monaco have a corner.
42' A pass from Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) is intercepted by Lukas Hradecky and the move breaks down.

39' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Mike Penders leaps like a salmon to deny him.
38' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
37' A player from Strasbourg takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Monaco will take a free kick near the side line.
36' A rebound bounces out to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
35' The goal by Strasbourg is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
34' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Benoit Bastien is going to take a look using VAR.
33' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
32' Total attempts – 3:3. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:1.
32' The free kick is delivered by Caio Henrique (Monaco) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

31' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Benoit Bastien blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Monaco, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
30' A pass by Lamine Camara (Monaco) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
29' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
24' Monaco take a short corner kick.

24' Caio Henrique (Monaco) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play. Monaco are awarded a corner kick.

23' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the right side of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Lukas Hradecky makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score.
23' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
22' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
21' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
19' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.

11' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukas Hradecky intercepts the ball.
8' The referee is firm and issues Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) a deserved yellow card.

4' Denis Zakaria slides a brilliant pass into Folarin Balogun (Monaco), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
